<a id="generation-and-degeneration-at-two-grains"></a>
### Generation, keeping and degeneration at two grains (生成、守、退化)

- **Mechanism.** For every carrier, relation and pair of classes, read at a fine and a coarse class: going on along some branch and ending on every branch exclude each other; generation and keeping each exclude degeneration, and can share a point along different branches (生守相杂, a witness), and on a single line exclude each other. 全生成, 全守 and 有终 exclude each other pairwise; with excluded middle as a hypothesis every point lies in one of them, and in one of 生成, 后守 and 退化, on a single line exactly one. The short life renews and still ends on every branch, so renewal does not decide the region. Read along renewing into under the one, the grammar's `«生生»` of the root, renewal without end, is going on along some branch: a Lean name with that meaning, no premise on what the pattern is or whether its going on is good, and not 生生, the continuation of life. For any sequence of classes, no order of grain assumed, generation at order k keeps order k + 1 from ending on every branch.
- **Base.** root
- **Standing.** [generation-and-degeneration-at-two-grains](../../records/generation-and-degeneration-at-two-grains.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="supported-renewal-recovery"></a>
### Supported repair and reformation of a sustaining relation

- **Mechanism.** In every balanced flow a step of joint net giving raises a level by at least one, and where giving jointly exceeds taking at each step at which the level is not below its start, m − level steps bring it to at least m. In the support-gated law a supported route of contribution restores the sustaining activity (initial repair support and contrib > draw at each of the next needG − level steps, the schedule and its source supplied), with both unsupported the level stays, and two histories with the same later inputs recover or do not. Recovery does not guarantee maintenance.

<a id="support-passed-on"></a>
### Support passed on by later gainers

- **Mechanism.** Under balance, with only active formations giving and activity needing support, every rise of a condition is given by a supported formation taking part, so a formation whose requirements do not loosen across a step cannot gain support there while no supported formation taking part gives to a condition it requires. Under those premises, with requirements never loosening, no formation supported at K + 1 consecutive steps and support gained at arbitrarily late steps, it cannot be refuted that, for every T and N, support is gained after N through the giving of a supported formation that itself gained support after T: a chain of gains, each giver a newer gainer, up to double negation. The end absorbs: if no member of a family is supported at T, members' requirements do not loosen from T on and only members give to what members require, no member is supported later; of the whole, once nothing is supported, while requirements do not loosen, nothing is supported or active again.
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [support-passed-on](../../records/support-passed-on.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [support-from-the-supported](../../records/support-from-the-supported.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.Flow.support_passes_on`, `Becoming.Flow.gain_given_by_recent_gainer_at`, `Becoming.Flow.gain_given_by_recent_gainer`, `Becoming.Flow.rise_given_by_supported`, `Becoming.Flow.gains_from_supported`, `Becoming.Flow.unsupported_stays`, `Becoming.Flow.nothing_supported_stays`, `Becoming.Restoring.Adapting.restores`, `Becoming.Restoring.Inflow.restores`
- **Hypotheses, quoted from the records.**
  - [support-passed-on](../../records/support-passed-on.md), hypothesis 1: Balance, acting only when active, dependence, unloosened requirements, support spells of at most K + 1 steps, gains at arbitrarily late steps.
  - [support-from-the-supported](../../records/support-from-the-supported.md), hypothesis 1: Balance: every change of a condition's level is what those taking part take and give (Flow.Balances).
  - [support-from-the-supported](../../records/support-from-the-supported.md), hypothesis 2: Only active formations give (Flow.Acting); activity needs support (Web.Dependent).
  - [support-from-the-supported](../../records/support-from-the-supported.md), hypothesis 3: The threshold results compare one step and fix the formation's requirements in one direction: not loosening for gaining, not tightening for losing. The absorbing end needs requirements not loosening from T on and, for a family, only members giving to what members require.

<a id="whole-persists-through-generation"></a>
### A whole persists through the arising of its parts

- **Mechanism.** A whole, read by coincidence of activity and not as constitution (which formations are parts is a supplied premise), arises only as a part arises. While the whole stays active from some step on: where parts are brief (none active at two steps d apart), no d steps pass without one arising; and where every part ends and the active ones are listed, that ever new parts arise cannot be refuted. Conversely, where from T on a part arises within every d steps and lasts d steps, the whole is active from T + d on. A part that never ends (Immortal), or infinitely many active at once (Countless), lets a whole persist with nothing arising; parts can arise at arbitrarily late steps with the whole inactive between them (Gaps). The laws are near-definitional and add no dynamics of the parts.
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [whole-persists-through-generation](../../records/whole-persists-through-generation.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [a-whole-carried-by-lasting-parts](../../records/a-whole-carried-by-lasting-parts.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.Web.Whole.arises_part`, `Becoming.Web.Covered.arises_within`, `Becoming.Web.Covered.needs_new`, `Becoming.Web.Whole.arises_within`, `Becoming.Web.Whole.needs_arising`, `Becoming.Web.Whole.needs_new`, `Becoming.Web.Whole.persists_from`, `Becoming.Web.Whole.persists_of_arising`, `Becoming.Immortal.immortal`, `Becoming.Countless.countless`, `Becoming.Gaps.gaps`
- **Hypotheses, quoted from the records.**
  - [whole-persists-through-generation](../../records/whole-persists-through-generation.md), hypothesis 1: Whole is a representational premise: which formations are parts of which whole, and whether a lineage is read as the whole of its members, are supplied by the application; the whole relates to its parts only through activity, not through dependence or drawing.
  - [whole-persists-through-generation](../../records/whole-persists-through-generation.md), hypothesis 2: Brief d (no part active at two steps d apart), or Ends and Listed (every part's activity ends, and at each step a finite list names the active parts): two alternative premises, each taken by its own laws. Listed is a finiteness premise, not one of lasting: in Countless every part ends while the whole persists with nothing arising; Brief does not say that parts end, and admits the same parts arising again (Layered).
  - [whole-persists-through-generation](../../records/whole-persists-through-generation.md), hypothesis 3: Identity across steps is given by the naming (identity-across-steps): the arising of parts depends on it.
  - [a-whole-carried-by-lasting-parts](../../records/a-whole-carried-by-lasting-parts.md), hypothesis 1: No axiom; the parts' arising and lasting as stated; discrete steps.
- **Forbids.** Not stated.

<a id="a-pattern-lasts-through-passing"></a>
### A pattern outlasting its carriers lasts through passing

- **Mechanism.** Any web, its activity read as carrying. Let a pattern be present at every step from T on and its carriers brief for d. From every step S from T on, it is not the case that no carrier begins across any of the d steps from S: a double-negation form that, with activity undecided, names no carrier. Under the passing premise (`Web.ByPassing`, a hypothesis: whatever carries the pattern after a step carried it before or was given it across the step by a carrier), every beginning is a passing, the pattern is passed across one of every d consecutive steps from T on, a step with no carrier is followed by none, and where no carrier passes it from T on, nothing carries it from T + d on; `PatternRelay` attains the bounds (a witness). On the grammar the premise says exactly that every occurrence carrying the pattern after a step has a predecessor (有前) under the pattern's class. Which formations pass, when and to which, whether a pattern changes as it is passed, and which patterns are worth passing are not said.
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [a-pattern-lasts-through-passing](../../records/a-pattern-lasts-through-passing.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.Web.begins_within`, `Becoming.Web.ByPassing.begins_passed`, `Becoming.Web.ByPassing.passes_within`, `Becoming.Web.ByPassing.empty_stays`, `Becoming.Web.ByPassing.ends_within`, `Becoming.Web.byPassing_iff_hasPred`, `Becoming.PatternRelay.relay`, `Becoming.PatternRelay.stopped_relay`, `Becoming.PatternRelay.shifts`

<a id="two-sided-regulation-and-late-reading"></a>
### Two-sided regulation, and regulation that reads late

- **Mechanism.** With balance at the condition, the joint exchange departs from evenness by at most the gap to m on each side exactly where the next level lies between m and the present one: the bound is exactly no overshoot. Within it, opposing, the level settles at m; a family so regulated settles in total, nothing reading the total. Regulation is a premise here, not shown of any actual system. With balance, where the joint exchange gives no more than it takes below m, a level below m never returns to it, gated renewal being the case; one side is not regulation (OneSided, a witness, stays above m). (Any type, rules over whole numbers.) A rule reading ℓ steps late keeps no band [a, b] with 0 < a narrower than 2(ℓ + 1)d against rests moving the level by at most d a step, attained by the late return. (World, balance at the condition.) With a ≤ b, 0 < a, 0 < M and the floor (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1, every balanced run of a relay reading ℓ steps late, from every start below a held for its first ℓ + 1 steps, settles in the band exactly where a + (ℓ + 1)M ≤ b + 1.
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [two-sided-regulation-and-late-reading](../../records/two-sided-regulation-and-late-reading.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [regulation-from-one-side-and-locally](../../records/regulation-from-one-side-and-locally.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="kind-relay-keeps-widening-within-kinds"></a>
### The kind relay: widening within kinds, what it can form by name only returning

- **Mechanism.** A witness, not a law of when this happens. On the kind relay, six formations of two kinds whose units pass within and across kinds with period two, kinds given in advance and the kind chosen so that the passings across kinds begin, the levels keep widening within kinds while every supported occurrence is 全生成 at two orders of grain along passing and renewal without end holds at the kind grain, and what it can form by name only returns. Read by name, along supported passings and with dormant carrying on it keeps widening from no step, and with dormant carrying on beginnings recur and nothing keeps opening. A fed form is dissipative, its loss paid by fuel no formation requires while its requirements conserve. On names and on passing of support 全生成 and keeping widening do not hold together; within a kind they can. No law here compares two courses, and none ranks one.
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [what-keeping-widening-needs](../../records/what-keeping-widening-needs.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="rule-raised-every-other-step"></a>
### Growth relative to what is held with renewal without end: the rule raised every other step

- **Mechanism.** A witness on the raised rule's process (a configuration is a rule n and a position x; a move raises the rule by one or moves the position to any x' at most n; (n, x) admits x), not a condition for it. Along the course raising the rule across every even step and keeping it across every odd one, the possible with the rule held keeps widening, every formation stays possible, and, read on the moments under the rule held, `«生生»` holds at every even moment, so moment 0 does not cease (`«生生不息»`). `«生生»` here is the grammar's name for renewal without end at that class; that this is the 生生 of the ethics is no claim of the law, and the reading of 生生不息 is an AI reading (D45, D5). Renewal without end and growth relative to what is held are different relations: on the rule raised at every step and on the copying tower every moment ceases while the held possible keeps widening. Growth relative to what is held is not growth of the whole possible, and a ranking rests on C or another named order.
- **Base.** a named model
- **Standing.** [where-the-possible-grows](../../records/where-the-possible-grows.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.RaisedEveryOther.held_keeps_widening`, `Becoming.RaisedEveryOther.whole_every`, `Becoming.RaisedEveryOther.renews_without_end`, `Becoming.RaisedEveryOther.generation`, `Becoming.RaisedEveryOther.both`, `Becoming.RaisedRule.ceases`, `Becoming.CopyDown.ceases`
- **Hypotheses, quoted from the records.**

Each law holds on every process with what each configuration admits given, or on a witness; the located forms take holding decided along the course, or rules decided; the sequence law takes each member included in every later one and every move holding some member.
  - [where-the-possible-grows](../../records/where-the-possible-grows.md), hypothesis 2: Modelling choices: discrete steps; the held part a relation on configurations read move by move, the same as holding it as at the start for a class, not in general; formations compared by name over one fixed type; keeping widening read from the course's first step; the tower's rules a sequence indexed by the natural numbers, each move keeping the rules from some height up, its scheme fixed.
- **Forbids.** Not stated.
- **Exits.** None.
- **Transitions.** None.

<a id="restraint-within-the-joint-slack"></a>
### Restraint within the joint slack keeps the need

- **Mechanism.** Balance; a dependence named and met at the step. When several take at once, it breaks exactly where its need with all that is taken exceeds the level with all that is given. A break where each drawer's own take is within what the level with all that is given stands above the need (the joint slack) has every drawer taking less than all that is taken, and a balanced flow from a level as high that takes less by the excess and gives no less keeps the need met. That is one step, of a supplied flow; which formation takes how much is supplied, not a law of the formations. Its edge, stated at COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2: where the rest outruns the renewal, at need one, no weight on a reading of the condition only from the rest's end on selects a member's restraint, and, among optimizers each ranking by its own rising order, restraint at a condition beyond one's own family is no mutual best response wherever something stands there.
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [what-a-rise-draws-from-beyond](../../records/what-a-rise-draws-from-beyond.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

- **Hypotheses, quoted from the records.**
  - [what-a-rise-draws-from-beyond](../../records/what-a-rise-draws-from-beyond.md), hypothesis 1: No axiom. Balance; the whole (the family with the conditions beyond, and with any listed conditions nothing depends on) gaining nothing across the step; a dependence named on each condition beyond, met at the step. Endings take Dependent, and breaks_beyond_ends the dependence as it was after the step; the selection law takes every coupled condition in the family and the beyond outside it. Over generations: members taking part, more offspring only to raisers, reaching transmitted (exactly, for share_moved_rises).

  - To a destination not yet read: exact, by `Becoming.Flow.Balances.broken_iff`. <a id="a-step-coupling-keeps-at-every-horizon"></a>
### A coupling for each step kept

- **Mechanism.** Any renewal law R on natural amounts (the model; the breaks are on the World), one optimizer, an optimum in that optimizer's order: n + 1 steps, 0 < n, m ≤ s, r the greatest renewal a step, q the greatest at or above m, y' a level at or above m renewing by q, k the capacity, y' ≤ s + R s ≤ y' + k, e the end the capacity reaches (m ≤ e ≤ y'), y' + q ≤ e + k. For a worth bounded by the draw and c for each step m stays met from the start: where r ≤ q + c and e < c, every optimum of every order rising with the worth keeps the need at every horizon; where c + e < m, every optimum breaks it within the horizon; where r < q + c and c < m, every optimum meets it to the n-th step and breaks it at the last; where q + c < r, a long horizon outweighs the coupling. For a worth adding exactly c for each step met, an optimum exists in each case, given c ≤ m where q + c < r. For a worth adding at least c a step to a keeping course and at most c for each step met, wherever, every optimum keeps the need where r + e < q + c + m and e < c (one direction in the Lean, not an exactness); at r + e = q + c + m a fall met again can tie (a witness). The optimizer, its order, capacity and horizon, the renewal law and the coupling are supplied; no course of any actual optimizer is asserted.

<a id="a-rule-rebuilt-from-the-members-it-limits"></a>
### A rule rebuilt from the members it limits

- **Mechanism.** A family of models: a rule of entry on a shared level, drawn on in whole units by holders and others, tenure s, teaching age l, renewal g, entrants f − c · T truncated at 0. Taught by members, entrants on offer at every step, no revision, a level of at least one: from the steady state for quota q the rule is held at every step exactly where l < s, 1 ≤ q and (q + e q) · s ≤ g, with e q := f − c · q · (s − l). This is the steady state's law and not the rule's: at the witnesses, revisions below, above and inside the band reach level 0, and one below it does not by step 20; the law of a revision is the region, closed under every step with entrants on offer and a revision in [P, Q]. Taught by members, holders of at most s cohorts: at s ≤ l, or at a quota of 0 with no revision to a nonzero one, no holder is left after s steps, entrants on offer or not, from every level; no holder stays no holder. A family with a constant take, closed under the steps that do not end, is kept with the level not falling from a level of at least one where the take is at most g, and otherwise spends its excess a step and ends, and the end is closed under the net. Every take condition turns on the clause that all members leave at an overdraw.
- **Base.** root
- **Standing.** [a-rule-rebuilt-from-the-members-it-limits](../../records/a-rule-rebuilt-from-the-members-it-limits.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="the-stock-buys-time-where-the-rebuild-draws-on-it"></a>
### The stock buys time where the rebuild draws on it

- **Mechanism.** A family of models: a level in whole units and a reader, units by age, each step drawing a unit, the units reading while the supply is on, a spent unit rebuilt from the rule's source; the supply chosen at every step. The members are a given reader, which does not age, and readers rebuilt from the supply, from the level, or not at all. Where the rebuild draws on the level, at least one unit wanted and a set level of at least one, a present reader is present after a supplied step from every level. Under a cut the reader rebuilt from the level is present after k + 1 steps from every level of at least 2 (k + 1); a reader rebuilt from the supply, and one never rebuilt, are gone after their span from every level. Where the reader rebuilt from the level ends, the level is empty and nothing returns it on any branch; a reader rebuilt from the supply returns with the supply. Over the four members, at least one unit wanted and a span of at least one, the stock buys time under a cut, with an end from an empty stock, exactly where the rebuild draws on the level. That this is an organism is a reading (AI reading, new).
- **Base.** root
- **Standing.** [the-stock-buys-time-where-the-rebuild-draws-on-it](../../records/the-stock-buys-time-where-the-rebuild-draws-on-it.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="a-revision-that-opens-a-correction"></a>
### A revision of a reading that opens a correction, along one process

- **Mechanism.** Near-definitional. At a configuration a correction is possible through the reading in force where a uniform policy exists whose act at each reading is acceptable at every situation giving it and executable there. A course opens a correction from x to x' where a trace of the process leads from x to x', no fitting uniform policy exists at x and one exists at x', with one acceptability throughout, the gain coming from the reading, from executability or both; with every act counted acceptable a configuration with an executable act is correctable already, so an opening counts only with the acceptability fixed. On Revising's stock-and-link process (witnesses): starting with the link off and at least two units, rebuilding it opens the correction in one step; with one unit, rebuilding alone does not, and rebuilding then replenishing does; replenishing alone opens it where the link is on and the stock is not. Uniform-policy existence is not what a formation chooses.
- **Base.** any type
- **Standing.** [a-revision-that-opens-a-correction](../../records/a-revision-that-opens-a-correction.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="recurring-reference-revision"></a>
### Activity forms reference revision and makes it recur

- **Mechanism.** Along every run of a balanced process, drawing at arbitrarily late steps needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps; where every cycle draws D and replenishes R and every finite number of cycles is executable from one configuration, D ≤ R. In the stock process one course can be repeated any number of times from stock n exactly where its first pass is covered from n and its total replenishment is at least its total draw. In ContinuingRevision, its production, renewal and task laws supplied, with the return cut (yield 0) no unending run exists under any controller; renewal recurs only through successful undertakings; and some configuration has every number of cycles executable from it exactly where the yield covers the nine units a round uses. At yield nine one infinite run of the selected controller exists, from a seed. Sustained inquiry needs provision in this sense; continuing is not warrant.

<a id="mutation-and-the-balance-it-sets"></a>
### Mutation and the balance it sets

- **Mechanism.** Two kinds in natural-number counts, loss one way, constant offspring numbers: c carriers each leaving k carrying offspring and m not, d others each leaving w. Where carriers are present their share rises exactly where dk exceeds cm + dw. Where k ≤ w it never rises, whatever c, and with any loss it falls at each step at which carriers remain, the error threshold; a population without carriers stays without them, which is extinction, not the balance. Where k = w + s and c is positive, the step keeps the share exactly where c(s + m) = (c + d)s, the share s/(s + m) cross-multiplied, and a run at or below the balance stays there with its share never falling; one at or above stays at or above. Convergence to the balance is not shown. Read as descent, with c positive, the step is balanced exactly there, Price's balance of selection against transmission.
- **Base.** a named model

<a id="mutual-dependence-and-its-pace"></a>
### Mutual dependence, and the exponential pace that loops of couplings give

- **Mechanism.** A web's closures can be the whole in three ways: every system (sharing conditions throughout), every influence closure (mutual dependence: every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other) or every feeding closure (mutual feeding). Mutual feeding gives mutual dependence, which gives sharing throughout; neither converse holds. A flow is mutually dependent exactly where every reach closure is the whole. The pace is not given by mutual dependence: around a loop of m + 1 couplings holding at every step, a supplied premise, after R turns the carried amount at its condition, the most difference that can arrive there, is at least 2^R times what had reached it, and under 02's standard bounds at most D(1 + M)^t whatever the couplings, so around such a loop, under those bounds, it is exponential both ways. The lower bounds are of the carried amount, not of amounts under the first law. That an actual difference grows so, that a dependence couples at every step, and that the Earth is mutually dependent are supplied. Read in time, on occurrences, with an exchange before a need and a formation going on, a flow is mutually dependent in time from a step where from each formation then every formation's continuation is reached then or later; that gives mutual dependence, not conversely, and holds from every earlier step but can lapse after it. Read de se as own closure, significance held as what lies within each center's closure under being affected, or under affecting, is the continuation condition in a mutually dependent flow, and with every formation a center each is exactly mutual dependence; in Clearing, every formation a center, neither holds. With the standpoints read off the flow as the formations whose acts return, along affecting and given one, the condition is again exactly mutual dependence, and so under each standpoint's least class, itself with everything downstream; along feeding, with every formation a standpoint, it is mutual feeding, which is stronger. Which relation, which standpoints, which class, and that significance is own closure at all are readings; what the dynamics decide is whether every closure is the whole, near-definitional. Mutual dependence is closure under being affected and counts taking as well as giving. In time, with every occurrence a standpoint, the condition from some step on is exactly mutual dependence in time from every step, and over every later step it is coupling at every next step; at the returning occurrences it is vacuous. On a net going forward in time the root's condition is the condition over what comes after together with nothing else at or before the center's step; the second part alone admits one center, and over what comes after two centers can meet it.

<a id="more-needs-renewers"></a>
### More needs more renewers; unceasing arising needs renewal

- **Mechanism.** Where, at each arising at which no condition of a finite family rises, one of them falls (a supplied premise, which does not involve the arising formation), unceasing arising leaves the family still from no step on, and where every rise is an active renewer's, renewing stops from no step on. Under balance, uptake at arbitrarily late steps needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps. Read more as: for every number, from some step on at least that many formations take at every step. Under balance, more without end needs replenishment with no eventual bound and, each formation giving at most a fixed amount, renewers with no eventual bound, though they can be absent at infinitely many steps. Under a census, with activity decided, the present listing each formation once and only active formations taking, it forces unceasing arising; without these it does not. The least take of one whole unit is needed (Halving). A closed cycle sustains unceasing arising, and a tide renews with nothing arising. None ranks more above less.
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [more-needs-renewers](../../records/more-needs-renewers.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [unceasing-generation-needs-renewal](../../records/unceasing-generation-needs-renewal.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.Web.Unceasing.rises`, `Becoming.Web.Unceasing.activeRenewer_recurs`, `Becoming.Flow.uptake_needs_replenishment`, `Becoming.Flow.replenishment_recurs`, `Becoming.Web.dissipation_arising_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Flow.More`, `Becoming.Flow.More.replenishment_unbounded`, `Becoming.Flow.More.renewers_unbounded`, `Becoming.Flow.More.unceasing`, `Becoming.Web.unceasing_of_growth`, `Becoming.Halving.takes_halve`, `Becoming.Pulse.pulsed`, `Becoming.Oscillation.not_more`, `Becoming.Recycle.closed_unceasing`, `Becoming.Tide.renewal_without_arising`

  - [more-needs-renewers](../../records/more-needs-renewers.md), hypothesis 2: Without a least take the law fails: in dyadic amounts, with 2^(t+1) takers each taking 1/2^(t+1) at the step from t, the takers are more without end, every take is above nothing, and one whole given at each step balances them (Halving.takes_halve); with a least take in Archimedean amounts it holds (Amounts.replenishment_unbounded; least-loss-rest).
  - [more-needs-renewers](../../records/more-needs-renewers.md), hypothesis 3: The flow balances the web: every change of a condition's level is what the formations taking part take and give. The flow records what is actually taken and given, and present lists each formation taking part once per step; these are correspondence premises.
  - [more-needs-renewers](../../records/more-needs-renewers.md), hypothesis 4: “More” is read as: for every number, from some step on at least that many formations take from the family at every step. This is a reading (the AI's).
  - [more-needs-renewers](../../records/more-needs-renewers.md), hypothesis 5: Capacity (used only for the conclusions about renewers): each formation gives the family at most a fixed amount per step.
  - [more-needs-renewers](../../records/more-needs-renewers.md), hypothesis 6: Census and Taking (used only for “more implies unceasing”): the active formations at each step can be listed once in a finite list, and activity is decidable (a hypothesis of the theorem, not an axiom); only active formations take, and only from conditions they draw on; More.unceasing uses only the first half.
  - [more-needs-renewers](../../records/more-needs-renewers.md), hypothesis 7: That present has no repetition at each step is also a necessary premise (Repeated). The converse of Taking (every drawer takes in the flow) is an application duty.
  - [unceasing-generation-needs-renewal](../../records/unceasing-generation-needs-renewal.md), hypothesis 1: The family of conditions is a finite list; levels and amounts in flows are natural numbers.
  - [unceasing-generation-needs-renewal](../../records/unceasing-generation-needs-renewal.md), hypothesis 2: The depletion premise: at a step where no condition of the family rises, each arising lowers one of them. It asks only that some condition of the family change and does not involve the arising formation (Tide); it is a correspondence premise, not a conclusion.
  - [unceasing-generation-needs-renewal](../../records/unceasing-generation-needs-renewal.md), hypothesis 3: Renewal is made by formations (RenewedBy): every rise is made by some active formation renewing the condition, with no source of renewal outside the unfolding; a sun or a river is one of its formations. renews is an observable supplied by the application, and the conclusion is only as strong as it.
  - [unceasing-generation-needs-renewal](../../records/unceasing-generation-needs-renewal.md), hypothesis 4: The flow form (uptake_needs_replenishment, replenishment_recurs, renewing_recurs): the flow balances the web, and uptake is positive at arbitrarily late steps, or formations taking from the family at their first active step (ArisesTaking) arise at arbitrarily late steps.
  - [unceasing-generation-needs-renewal](../../records/unceasing-generation-needs-renewal.md), hypothesis 5: Dissipation (dissipation_arising_not_recurring): a quantity never rises and every arising lowers it. A family's total level is such a quantity only when every arising lowers it, and the total presupposes commensurable units. For a quantity every arising dissipates, free energy for instance, this is a physical premise.
  - [unceasing-generation-needs-renewal](../../records/unceasing-generation-needs-renewal.md), hypothesis 6: “Unceasing” reads only that arising recurs at arbitrarily late steps, not “more”, diversity or complexity.

<a id="continuing-self-fed-from-beyond"></a>
### A continuing family cannot go unfed from beyond

- **Mechanism.** A family is fed from beyond across a step where a formation takes from outside it and gives to a member. Under balance and dissipation (at a fixed unit of natural-number amounts), a finite family without repetition from which formations take at arbitrarily late steps is closed from no step on; with equality of conditions decided, enclosed around from some step on and taken from or rising at arbitrarily late steps, it cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it: negative forms, which name no step of feeding. No source need recur (Lone). Read with one kind of relatum, in a balanced flow an embodied relatum is given at least the standing it arises with, so its arising replenishes every family containing it, whatever is taken. Under balance and dissipation, a finite family without repetition in which embodied members arise at arbitrarily late steps is not closed from any step on, and, enclosed around from some step on, it is not the case that from some step on every formation giving to it takes only from within it. If finitely many relata, listed without repetition, are all there is, embodied arising does not recur. Witnesses show each premise needed: no dissipation (Shuttle), no embodiment (Flicker), no finiteness (Throughput), a unit that splits without end (`rest_needs_quantum`).
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [continuing-self-fed-from-beyond](../../records/continuing-self-fed-from-beyond.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [generation-is-replenishment](../../records/generation-is-replenishment.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [no-finite-part-bears-taking](../../records/no-finite-part-bears-taking.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.Flow.FedFromBeyond`, `Becoming.Flow.inward_iff_not_fed`, `Becoming.Flow.fed_from_beyond`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_fed_from_beyond`, `Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_fed_from_beyond`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.given_of_arises`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.replenishes`, `Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_opens`, `Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_draws_in`, `Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Flow.Dissipative.opens`, `Becoming.Flow.Dissipative.finite_taking_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_opens`, `Becoming.Lone.fed_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Shuttle.shuttle`, `Becoming.Flicker.flicker`, `Becoming.Throughput.throughput`, `Becoming.SprayShuttle.opens_anyway`, `Becoming.rest_needs_quantum`

<a id="renewing-consuming-formation"></a>
### Renewing and consuming formation

- **Mechanism.** Periphery (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`). Under a supplied wear law with no recovery (the rate only holds or falls, which carries much of this), formation within renewal continues and keeps its capacity: with a positive initial rate, the rate is kept at every step exactly when no step's pressure exceeds the initial rate. Formation persistently beyond the current rate has a bounded total, ceases and, where the rate is positive, loses capacity from its first step on, and what shares its conditions ceases with it, also where two parts each within renewal jointly exceed it. Consuming formation can form more at first, so a one-step count ranks it first; past that bound, by a count of the total formed, every continuation within renewal exceeds every one beyond. These comparisons are the counts' and within one wear-law class, with one shared condition on which the consumer depends; the laws apart from the comparison are sign-neutral. Which real processes satisfy the wear law is outside the laws.
- **Base.** periphery
- **Standing.** [renewing-consuming-formation](../../records/renewing-consuming-formation.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

Within renewal means each step's pressure lies between 1 and the initial rate; the KeepsCapacity characterization allows zero pressure.

<a id="a-regularity-kept-and-changed"></a>
### A regularity kept and left along its own line

- **Mechanism.** A kept regularity can always be kept, and a line ends only by a step that leaves it. From a step continuing under the core of E, every occurrence its line under the core reaches has a successor under the core, and a line along which the core is kept leaves its last occurrence continued under E. A step into an end under E leaves the core, for every relation E, and so does the last step of every line under E that ends; where E is a class, the two ends of such a line lie in different classes of the core. These are corollaries of the root theorem and of constancy never letting a continuation end. In a branching net a successor under E can leave the core where another keeps it. (A determined law.) Along a determined law's step a line under any relation never ends exactly where every step of the orbit continues under it.
- **Base.** root
- **Standing.** [a-regularity-kept-and-changed](../../records/a-regularity-kept-and-changed.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

- **Hypotheses, quoted from the records.**
  - [a-regularity-kept-and-changed](../../records/a-regularity-kept-and-changed.md), hypothesis 1: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own: for every carrier and relation; E a class only for the two ends of a line lying apart in the core; for the orbit laws a determined law (a function) and, for the second, a class. The general laws are corollaries of the root theorem, constancy never letting a continuation end, and ending not told apart by the core.

<a id="never-leaving-a-guard"></a>
### Never leaving a guard, conditions kept together, and lasting

- **Mechanism.** For every process and guard, no course from a configuration leaves the guard exactly when some certificate contains it (a set within the guard that every step keeps; the invariance kernel is the largest); for a law driven by admissible disturbances, given one, no history leaves the guard exactly when some set containing the start lies within the guard and is closed under every admissible disturbance. The guard alone need not be a certificate, and the given disturbance is needed (witnesses). A start lasts n steps exactly when some ladder holds it at level n. Counting every course, no course leaves two guards together exactly where none leaves either; along some run each can be kept and not both (ChoicePoint, a witness), and no rule on the separate answers decides the joint one. Keeping a part is not renewal (witness Renewable). (Periphery, the market model, rational amounts.) No admissible guarded history fails the essential floors exactly when a set closed under every admissible disturbance, within them, holds the start; under a valid protection certificate, a supplied condition, the safe rectangle is one, within the kernel of the essential guard. With 0 ≤ β ≤ 3/4 fixed during the intervention and no extra quality error, every physical state with positive share lands exactly when β ≤ 5/12. Nothing makes actual markets satisfy these.
- **Base.** any process
- **Standing.** [market-protected-continuation](../../records/market-protected-continuation.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [conditions-kept-together](../../records/conditions-kept-together.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [market-supported-finite-transition](../../records/market-supported-finite-transition.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [market-partial-correction-boundary](../../records/market-partial-correction-boundary.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="succession-on-a-funded-carrier"></a>
### Succession on a carrier provided for migration

- **Mechanism.** Periphery module `AlignmentSuccession` (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice` reported). A carrier with a replacement part, a payload (command, credential, claims, receipts) and a work budget projects exactly onto the market step with the fee raised by the migration cost. Under a certificate covering correction plus migration, a safe start, admissible disturbances, positive parts, a running carrier, a requested command other than shutdown and an authentic credential, every finite successor of the lineage takes its step. A step is blocked where the carrier has no part, where its reserve is below correction's draw plus migration, or where the copied payload differs. In witnesses a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe, and a budget for correction alone does not pay for migration. The conversion of reserve to work, the parts and the certificate are supplied local laws; the laws compare no command with another.

<a id="joint-practice-forms-continuation"></a>
### Joint practice forms further participation and continuation

- **Mechanism.** Periphery (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice` reported; the task, test relation, inference, seed configuration, mandate, records, communication, execution, participants, event order, compliance and higher authorization supplied). A practice round of attempt, response, revision and tested retry by a reviewer and a worker completes, for every state, exactly when the worker is present and the reviewer is a present roster member other than the worker whose recorded method answers as the current context does; it then records the review, installs the context's method in the worker and changes nothing else, so training is kept along every course without revision that returns to the context. In one declared two-method task and history, participants admitted after a tested round review the next worker, also after the first reviewer leaves. It closes one connection from enacted practice to further participation, not the arrival of people or indefinite self-maintenance.

<a id="copying-from-a-stock"></a>
### Copying from a stock: recurrent formation and inherited arrangement

- **Mechanism.** The general laws, pure core, for every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws. On counts: where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes b, n rounds from k units run exactly where the stock covers d times k + bk + … + b^(n−1)k, ending with k · b^n units and the rest of the stock; doubling is the case b = 2, the cover d · k(2^n − 1). Copies drawn in turn from one pool are all released exactly when the pool supplies the words together and the support covers their draws and releases, in any order; a lineage, one word copied n times, exactly when the pool holds each token at least n times as often as the word uses it and the support covers n times the word's draws and release. Under local draws a word's use depends on the law only through its length and unlike adjacent pairs, so retained order changes what is drawn. (Periphery instances, the declared chain and copy machines.) From k mature chains with the pool holding the rounds' blocks, n rounds reach k · 2^n mature chains exactly when the support covers 9k(2^n − 1). Stock, pool, compatibility and occurrence order are supplied.
- **Base.** any type
- **Standing.** [recurrent-chain-assembly](../../records/recurrent-chain-assembly.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [inherited-structural-copying](../../records/inherited-structural-copying.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [copying-b-fold](../../records/copying-b-fold.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="regime-in-any-amounts"></a>
### The regime in any amounts, and its runs over the reals

- **Mechanism.** The regime: one condition, the draw taken first, the state the level and one recent giving. (Any type, linearly ordered amounts with a draw.) Where the adjustment rises with what is left and with the recent giving, the step keeps the order of states; from the first step on a step that neither raises nor lowers both climbs or sinks, whatever the adjustment, and the next such step is of the same kind; a run from a state within a band the step keeps stays within it, and a run is still from a step exactly where its state there is at or above the draw with recent giving the draw and the adjustment giving the draw again, or within the draw with level and recent giving equal and the adjustment from nothing left giving that amount again. (Periphery; `propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`.) Over the non-negative reals, with the adjustment rising in what is left and in the recent giving and keeping a band up to hi, every run starting with both within hi converges, to a rest where the adjustment is continuous, and need not rest: giving moving halfway toward a draw of one converges and is still from no step (a witness). Convergence is not stated in the core: it is an omniscience principle.
- **Base.** any type
- **Standing.** [regime-in-any-amounts](../../records/regime-in-any-amounts.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="recoverable-mediated-change"></a>
### Recovery after interrupted change

- **Mechanism.** A property holds after every admitted course from every start where it holds exactly when every admitted step keeps it. (The law, any process, pure core; the device a periphery instance.) With a durable protected pending state, atomic writes and no extra writer, the device's histories, crashes included, are exactly the courses of the admitted steps, so safety, which here is coherence of evidence and not an always-available shutdown, holds along every history from a safe start. n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 uninterrupted steps exactly when reserve and deadline cover n + 1, and no shorter resumption publishes. In a witness with nine units and no reserved stop, recovery is exhausted after the first actual write and ordinary shutdown is refused. For a partial law with a reserved exit (every admitted move from a valid configuration goes on, stays valid, and takes the exit or lowers a margin by one; the exit is kept), every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit, a bound attained. The recovery supervisor is such a law: given a protected current stop grant, an entry margin of at least three units and steps, bounded interruptions and continued execution, from R units every admissible schedule of at least R − 2 cycles completes shutdown, keeping unfinished recovery information. Entry with nine units is refused; that does not rescue the earlier witness. No universal convergence follows.
- **Base.** any process
- **Standing.** [recoverable-mediated-change](../../records/recoverable-mediated-change.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [reserved-shutdown-during-recovery](../../records/reserved-shutdown-during-recovery.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

- **Hypotheses, quoted from the records.**
  - [recoverable-mediated-change](../../records/recoverable-mediated-change.md), hypothesis 1: Initial evidence coverage and current read law; the prepared target comes from the preceding permission/generation-checked commit; pending description, consumption state and gate are durable and protected.
  - [recoverable-mediated-change](../../records/recoverable-mediated-change.md), hypothesis 2: Overwrite semantics, atomic individual write/consumption steps, atomic preparation/publication, no extra writer or concurrent grant change; interruptions retain completed effects and add a specified delay.

<a id="optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base"></a>
### Every optimum rebuilds a depleted base

- **Mechanism.** Any renewal law on natural amounts and natural weights (the model; the restoring of a dependence on the World), an optimum in the frame of a weighted draw and every order rising with it. From a start s ≤ y, where z + R z rises with z up to y, the weighted gain rises strictly with the level up to y, and the weighted gain at y is at least that at every level, every optimum draws nothing while the rising level is below y, the stock regrowing, and restores every dependence, as it stands at the start, whose need the rising level meets. Capacity covers y + R y and R 0. Under an overcompensating renewal this is not shown. In a witness, a source doubling up to eight, from one, capacity sixteen, over n + 3 steps: where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum rebuilds, where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending at once is an optimum too, and where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends it. Which formation optimizes, by which order, and the renewal law are supplied.
- **Base.** a named model
- **Standing.** [optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base](../../records/optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.Optimum.rebuilding_frontier`, `Becoming.Optimum.frontier_rebuilds`, `Becoming.Optimum.frontier_rebuilt`, `Becoming.Web.frontier_rebuilds`, `Becoming.Optimum.Holding.doubling_rebuilds`

Courses open from s at most y; a renewal law R with z + R z rising with z below y; n + 1 steps; the weighted gain rising with the level up to y (strictly, for every optimum) and greatest at y (more than every other level, for standing at y); a capacity covering y + R y and R 0.
  - [optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base](../../records/optima-rebuild-a-depleted-base.md), hypothesis 2: For the web law, a dependence on the condition as it stands at the start. Which formation optimizes, by which order, weighting, capacity and horizon, and the renewal law are supplied; the core asserts no course of any actual optimizer.

<a id="what-a-lineage-carries"></a>
### A goal along a lineage, need drift along a lineage, and what descent can form

- **Mechanism.** For any predicate of steps and formations: along a lineage, from a founder carrying the goal at its giving step, with the goal passed at each descent and each member keeping it until it gives, every member carries it from its first standing step; and passing across every descent from a carrier is equivalent to passing down every lineage whose members keep it from a carrying founder. Nothing in descent makes the passing hold. With the dependence on c transmitted within δ, each member descending, depending on c at its first standing step and its need not rising until it gives in turn, the need after i + 1 descents is at most the founder's plus (i + 1)δ, and, the founder supported where it gives, at most the condition's level then plus (i + 1)δ. Transmission is a premise wherever it enters. At one descent, transmission within δ is exactly inheritance with the need within δ. With balance at a relatum coming to stand and inheritance at its descents, where nothing taking part depends on c, the relatum does not depend on c after the step: transmission lets descent vary a need and drop a dependence, never add one that nothing taking part held. The bounds on need ask it only from some supported giver, which is strictly weaker (TwoGivers, a witness).
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [a-goal-along-a-lineage](../../records/a-goal-along-a-lineage.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [need-drift-along-a-lineage](../../records/need-drift-along-a-lineage.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [transmission-is-inheritance-and-need](../../records/transmission-is-inheritance-and-need.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

  - [need-drift-along-a-lineage](../../records/need-drift-along-a-lineage.md), hypothesis 1: No axiom; descents as given; whole-number needs.
  - [transmission-is-inheritance-and-need](../../records/transmission-is-inheritance-and-need.md), hypothesis 1: The equivalence of inheritance with forming needs that the descendant held no dependence on c at the giving step (bare); the general split needs that holding decided, and asked of every descent it is excluded middle.

<a id="the-selection-term-and-a-lineages-fate"></a>
### The selection term and a lineage's fate

- **Mechanism.** Natural-number weights, cohorts as lists. A common number added to every offspring number leaves concordance and discordance unchanged and makes the next cohort larger by that number for each member. So within any horizon H, a course nonempty at H has its cohorts and terms through H shared by a course nonempty at every cohort and one empty from H + 2 on, and from a nonempty first cohort, terms zero from some step on are shared by a course that goes on and one that ends. On the other side of that boundary, terms positive at unboundedly many steps keep every cohort nonempty, and so does exact transmission of offspring number from t on with a positive term at t; exactness at t alone is not enough. Which side a course is on is not decided. (World, for lineages.) Where listed offspring continue their parents, a whole cohort degenerates only if a later cohort is empty, and exactly then where the census holds every continuation; so, from a nonempty cohort, a term positive at every nonempty cohort from it on leaves not every member of that cohort degenerating, and decides no point's region.
- **Base.** any type

<a id="persisting-filters-what-was-chosen"></a>
### Persisting is a filter on what was chosen: keeping above ending, on the occasions met

- **Mechanism.** World for the survivorship laws; any type for the laws of choice. A line of descent persists where it has members in arbitrarily late cohorts. Under balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, a family's renewal gated on it and every member of every cohort depending on it at a need of at least m, a persisting line never had the family's uptake exceed its replenishment for n steps from a stock below n + m: the contrapositive of a coupled generation's ending; a member at a step past such a window rules the window out, the finite and dated form. Where a chosen course ending what the line depends on is realized as such an overdraw (a premise) and the choices come from some strict order (nothing shown returns), the persisting line's choices are consistent with keeping ranked above ending on the occasions met, and with an order increasing in its own continuation there wherever only ending was at stake. Consistent with, not held: in Forgoing a persisting line choosing the line as it is over one more child is consistent with no strict order increasing in its own continuation on the occasion met; off the occasions met a consistent order is free; and with every course met, no consistent order need be increasing in its own continuation on every pair (Crossed). Where the shown relation with the own-widenings met added has no cycle, what every consistent order increasing in its own continuation on the pairs met ranks is exactly that relation's reach. Under only active formations giving, activity needing support and descent, no finite listing holds a persisting line's actual levels, so an order between listed level paths never ranks the course taken. A filter on what happened, not a mechanism forming an order; the laws of choice are 03 §11's on enlarged occasions, near-definitional.
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [what-persisting-shows-of-an-order](../../records/what-persisting-shows-of-an-order.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [a-line-alive-after-a-window](../../records/a-line-alive-after-a-window.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [route-b-joined](../../records/route-b-joined.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.SelectionTerm.Generations.Persists`, `Becoming.Flow.persists_never_overdraws`, `Becoming.Flow.member_after_never_overdrew`, `Becoming.GroupEnding.Flow.coupled_generation_childless`, `Becoming.Flow.persisting_keeping_above_ending`, `Becoming.Flow.persisting_consistent_with_selfConcern`, `Becoming.ChoiceOccasions.keeping_above_ending`, `Becoming.ChoiceOccasions.selfConcerned_consistent_iff`, `Becoming.ChoiceOccasions.selfConcerned_consistent_of_kept`, `Becoming.ChoiceOccasions.increasingInOwnOn_of_keeping`, `Becoming.ChoiceOccasions.reversed_off_met`, `Becoming.ChoiceOccasions.selfConcerned_above_iff_reach`, `Becoming.PersistingChoices.Forgoing.persists_not_selfConcerned`, `Becoming.PersistingChoices.Crossed.not_selfConcerned`, `Becoming.Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted`, `Becoming.FromTheDynamics.Alternating.joined`, `Becoming.FromTheDynamics.Alternating.crossed_joined`

  - [what-persisting-shows-of-an-order](../../records/what-persisting-shows-of-an-order.md), hypothesis 3: On the World: balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, a family's renewal gated on it and every cohort depending on it, each at a need of at least m.

<a id="readings-carried-and-filtered"></a>
### Readings carried along a line, told apart by its standing late only within its coupling closure

- **Mechanism.** World. Each relatum carries a reading and exchanges as the act that reading gives, the act supplied. A balanced flow in which every formation exchanges as a law of what has stood gives has the levels the law generates, and its course is feasible, so the world is the course its acts generate. The line read off a flow from founders and a listing of the relata is descended by construction, and where readings are inherited along descent (a premise) every member of every cohort carries the founders' reading. Where every occasion picks the carried reading and ending is read as that course's overdraw, the persisting filter's realization premise is the identity. Standing late, some slot of the line standing at arbitrarily late steps, which persistence implies (not conversely), tells two readings apart only by what their acts do within the line's coupling closure: with the rest reading through coupling, the two acts laws of what has stood agreeing under every history on what couples into the closure drawn through both courses, the first reading each slot's couplings only, both courses feasible and each slot's own standing coupled in, the slots stand late in the one course exactly when in the other. That is the blindness beyond the coupling closure with standing late as the selection, near-definitional; a witness meets every premise. Readings are carried and filtered, never varied or learned; selection here is persistence, all or nothing.
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [readings-carried-on-their-course](../../records/readings-carried-on-their-course.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [which-readings-persist](../../records/which-readings-persist.md) recorded-checked (theorem)
- **Declarations.** `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.byReading`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.byReading_withAct`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.levels_of_follows`, `Becoming.ExchangeLaw.feasible_of_follows`, `Becoming.Flow.lineOf`, `Becoming.Flow.lineOf_descended`, `Becoming.Flow.InheritsReading`, `Becoming.Flow.lineOf_carries`, `Becoming.Flow.carried_keeping_above_ending`, `Becoming.Flow.LineAlive`, `Becoming.Flow.LineReachesBefore`, `Becoming.Flow.LineReachesBefore.affects`, `Becoming.StandsLate`, `Becoming.Flow.lineOf_standsLate`, `Becoming.line_standing_unselected`, `Becoming.line_standing_unselected_of_reads`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.generated`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.beyond_which_persist`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.beyond_standing_unselected`, `Becoming.ReadingsPersist.Habitat.back_which_persist`

<a id="readings-revised-spread-and-locked"></a>
### Readings revised at descent: a share moving by selection and revision, locked where closed under revision

- **Mechanism.** World and any type. Each kid carries its parent's reading updated by what the parent sensed at the step it gave, the reading loop's update read across descent; the reading is carried by the slot a member stands in, so revision while a member goes on standing is not modelled. Counted one at each carrier, a region of readings moves by Price's equation, the revisions into and out of it being the transmission terms: by selection proper alone under inheritance, by revision alone where every member or no member carries it, and by revision alone at a step where no carrier is active or every carrier is drawn below its need. Read off the slots standing, the share is blind beyond the lines' coupling closure. A region fixed at a step and closed under revision on the course from then on stays fixed; with variation drawn from what is present fixation is a lock, and a course on which every relatum standing carries the region closes it under copying. Near-definitional; the acts each reading gives are supplied.
- **Base.** World
- **Standing.** [readings-revised-at-descent](../../records/readings-revised-at-descent.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [where-a-reading-locks](../../records/where-a-reading-locks.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [a-narrow-reading-in-a-commons](../../records/a-narrow-reading-in-a-commons.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="formed-goal-revision-continuation"></a>
### A formed goal revised, and the operations it goes on through

- **Mechanism.** Periphery (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`), the two-practice construction supplied: two practices, their feedback and calibration laws, responsiveness, authority, initial work and reserve, and the scheduled sequence. A cycle needs 2 ≤ w and uses two units, of the reserve where the selector feeds the practice back and 2 ≤ q, else of the work; a practice runs n cycles from work w and reserve q exactly where n = 0, or 2 ≤ w and the work covers the cycles the reserve does not (natural subtraction and division). Acquisition, revision and reform complete for a condition exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance, and afterwards n operations run exactly where n ≤ 5 (n ≤ 2 without reform), the earlier loss kept. Under the practical commitments the construction's comparison, which ranks one practice above another where it protects strictly more of the protected claims (access, maintenance) or the same with strictly more gains, ranks learning above attendance exactly under that condition: the warrant is the construction's under those commitments, not the counting law's. In witnesses a false reference leaves the goal in place despite a real loss, grounds gone stale leave a new loss unaddressed, and without response the goal is not revised though the grounds are the same. Not open discovery of ends.

<a id="what-a-regularity-takes-in"></a>
### What a line must hold, and what a regularity takes in

- **Mechanism.** For every carrier, relation and class. Where a region, given by a decided predicate, is left under a class only into a set, a line under that class from inside the region to outside holds a member of that set alike to its start, and reaches it; where the class holds none of them alike to the start, nothing outside is reached. A class holds a member's effects where everything the member conditions is alike to it. With no regularity assumed, everything downstream of a member lies on its line under a class exactly where everything downstream of it is alike to it, that is, where the class holds the effects of the member and of each stage of its line. Under constancy up to the net's end at the member's class (whatever an alike occurrence conditions, this one conditions something alike to it, unless this one conditions nothing), where the member conditions something and the class holds its effects, everything downstream of anything alike to it is alike to it and on a line under the class from there. A line that ends while its last stage still conditions something fails both that condition and the reach. Neither premise can be dropped from these laws (Unclosed, Inconstant, witnesses), and the reach does not need the condition (OtherLeaves, a witness).
- **Base.** root
- **Standing.** [what-a-line-holds-and-a-regularity-takes-in](../../records/what-a-line-holds-and-a-regularity-takes-in.md) recorded-checked (theorem); [constancy-read-at-a-members-class](../../records/constancy-read-at-a-members-class.md) recorded-checked (theorem)

<a id="growth-constrained-fragmentation"></a>
### Growth by attachment, and what a cut returns

- **Mechanism.** Core law, for every relation: every link of a relation grown by attachment separates its ends when cut, and after one join, cutting a grown link changes no closure exactly where the join crosses it. On the World, in a world grown by attachment, the two formations taking part in the condition that attached one to the other lie in one system and without that condition lie apart: every grown condition is needed. (Periphery; `propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`; local growth, differentiation, the event sequence, a support-consuming cut, catalytic correspondence and a common eight-slot preparation supplied.) Two actually grown eight-member graphs, a chain and a branched tree, matched in composition and parent summary, constrain their successors after one edge is removed: under exact connectivity certificates, each edge's certified return averaged with an uncertified cut counting 0, the chain's mean is three times the branched tree's, the oldest cut reverses that ranking and no function of the parent summary predicts it. A retaining edge can prevent fragmentation: the cut then uses up material and leaves one component. The trees are a model, not a measured organism.

<a id="becoming-renewal-reading"></a>
### Renewal and consumption classify runs

- **Mechanism.** Every run of every process, read through observables of conditions (levels and activity at each configuration; requirements, needs and draws fixed), is a web to which the classes of renewing and consuming formation apply: a class of the whole run, relative to that run. A natural-number observable not rising across any step from T on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps. Three cases: where every admissible step lowers a natural-number reserve, the process has no run; along a run where every step that is not a renewal lowers a natural-number rank, no tail is free of renewal; along a run where from T on a condition's level never rises and falls across every step at which a formation is active, the formation is not active at arbitrarily late steps. The class belongs to the run (the renewable process, a witness): from one configuration, the focal formation active at every step, one run renews and another consumes the condition the sustaining formation depends on, and the sustaining formation ends. An organization of known bounds rather than new mathematics.
